description: Computes a semi-supervised multi-view Shared-Private Product-of-Experts Variational Information Bottleneck across M=5 patient-level encoder vectors (each 256-dim fold-whitened PCA). Inputs: 5 aligned patient vectors for labelled and unlabelled training-fold patients plus integer PAM50 labels for labelled training patients only (5 vectors per held-out labelled patient at inference). Architecture: M view-specific 2-layer LayerNorm-GELU-Dropout MLPs map each view m to shared diagonal Gaussian posterior parameters (mu_m, clamp(logvar_m, -6, 6)) in R^{shared_dim} and deterministic private latents z_priv_m in R^{private_dim}. Closed-form precision-weighted Product-of-Experts combines active views S with prior N(0,I): prec_poe = 1 + sum_{m in S} exp(-logvar_m), mu_poe = prec_poe^{-1} sum_{m in S} exp(-logvar_m)*mu_m. View decoders reconstruct all M views from [z_shared, z_priv_m] (substituting zero private vector for masked views m not in S). A cosine-normalized linear head with learnable scale maps z_shared (using deterministic mu_poe at test time) to 4 class scores f(z). Training: AdamW on mixed labelled+unlabelled mini-batches with random view masking (p=0.3, keeping >=2 views) and labelled latent mixup, minimizing logit-adjusted cross-entropy CE(f(z) + tau*log(pi_train), y) on labelled samples plus rec_weight*MSE across all M views, linearly warmed beta_kl*KL(q_poe||N(0,I)), and orth_weight*sum(||z_shared^T z_priv_m||_F^2 + 0.1*||z_priv_m||_2^2) on all training+unlabelled samples. After convergence, fits scalar temperature T>0 (inner-val NLL) for calibrated probabilities p_hat = softmax((f(mu_poe)+log(pi_train))/T) and simplex weights alpha in Delta^3 (coordinate ascent on inner-val macro-F1) for discrete predictions argmax_c(alpha_c * p_hat_c), averaging p_hat across n_seeds_ensemble seeds. Outputs: calibrated 4-class probabilities, macro-F1-calibrated class predictions, consensus embeddings, and epoch loss/metric curves.
